# Open Speech ASR

Open Speech ASR is a local speech-to-text productivity app for desktop dictation.

Canonical support page: https://rentry.co/open-speech-asr-support-20260617
Privacy policy: https://rentry.co/open-speech-asr-privacy-20260616
Contact: 3141791843@qq.com

## What Open Speech ASR Does

Open Speech ASR records speech from the user's microphone, transcribes it, and copies the result to the clipboard. Users can paste the result manually into another app.

The app supports local ASR engines and optional user-configured external API modes. If an external API mode is configured, the selected provider's privacy policy and terms apply to that optional external service.

## Privacy

Open Speech ASR does not require an account. The app does not collect, sell, or share personal data with the developer.

## Permissions

- Microphone: records speech for transcription.
- Input Monitoring: detects global shortcuts while another app is active.
- Screen Recording: optional context capture for post-processing features when enabled by the user.
